title: MEA: A Reward-Driven Multi-Agent System for Faithful Model Explanations
summary:
arXiv:2610.02480v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Recent years have seen the employment of a plethora of machine learning (ML) models in high-stakes domains, but they remain largely opaque to the practitioners who act on their predictions. While post-hoc explanation methods offer a lens into this model behavior, wielding them effectively demands expertise most domain experts lack: navigating high-dimensional outputs, selecting the best explanations, and synthesizing evidence across disparate tool
